_note: Project-authored synthetic ownership data. NOT an S1000D field.
S1000D carries responsiblePartnerCompany natively, but populating it would
change the bytes of a sample DM and therefore every chunk id derived from
it (chunking.base.make_chunk_id), invalidating the corpus manifest. Ruling
System 49 (APU) is deliberately absent so the unrouted path stays visible:
an unknown owner must surface as unknown, never as a plausible guess.
